name: music-bot
description: Always-on Telegram music bot on Cloudflare Workers — search, recognize, download, inline mode. By Ali Mousavi (@AliMsvD).

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Random secret for Telegram webhook verification. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

LINK_SECRET.description: Random secret for signing download links. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

ADMIN_SETUP_KEY.description: Random key for the one-time `/setup` route. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 16`.
